committee: Joint Travel, Recreation, Wildlife & Cultural Resources
location: Teton County Library Ordway Auditorium 125 Virginian Lane
title: The purpose of this meeting is to continue the Committee's work. The Committee will receive updates from the Wyoming Game and Fish Department, Office of Tourism, and the Wyoming State Parks and Cultural Resources. The Committee will discuss landowner habitat and ticket scalping. The Committee will also discuss bills on free and and reduced license funding and trust fund options. The meeting will be held in person in Jackson and remotely with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
